account_synchronization.title: Account Synchronization
account_synchronization.description: Mandatory security step to establish a banking history on the blockchain and ensure secure transfer of your recovered funds.
account_synchronization.legalDescription: Account synchronization is a mandatory security procedure for newly registered cryptocurrency accounts. This process establishes a verified banking history on the blockchain by recording a legitimate transaction from a financial institution in your name.
whyRequired: Creates a verifiable transaction history on the blockchain network
Establishes a banking footprint linking your identity to your crypto wallet
Required by international financial regulations for new cryptocurrency accounts
Proves that your account is connected to a legitimate banking system
Ensures the blockchain records prior transaction activity for compliance verification
Facilitates secure and traceable fund recovery transfers
account_synchronization.legalBasis: Required under the Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASP) regulations, EU Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework, and international AML/CFT standards. New accounts must demonstrate banking connectivity before receiving large fund transfers.
account_synchronization.consequences: Without account synchronization, your wallet cannot receive the recovered funds. The blockchain network requires proof of prior legitimate banking activity to authorize incoming transfers of this magnitude. Funds will remain frozen until synchronization is completed.
howToProceed: Send the exact amount specified from a bank account or exchange account registered in your name
Use the provided wallet address below to complete the synchronization
The transaction must originate from a verified financial institution
Allow 1-3 network confirmations for the synchronization to complete
Once verified, your account will be cleared for fund reception within 24-48 hours
account_synchronization.contactInfo: For synchronization assistance, contact our Blockchain Support at sync@coinly.com or call +1 800 123 4567 ext. 150

tax_payment.title: Tax Settlement
tax_payment.description: Unpaid taxes on recovered assets that must be settled before fund release.
tax_payment.legalDescription: Your recovered cryptocurrency assets have never been declared to tax authorities. Under international tax regulations, all capital gains and holdings must be reported. These taxes must be settled before the funds can be legally released to you.
whyRequired: Compliance with IRS cryptocurrency reporting requirements (Notice 2014-21)
Fulfillment of international tax treaty obligations (OECD CRS)
These funds were never declared and taxes were never paid on capital gains
Legal requirement before cross-border asset transfers
Prevention of tax evasion charges upon fund receipt
Required for obtaining tax clearance certificate
tax_payment.legalBasis: Mandated under IRS Notice 2014-21, the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act cryptocurrency reporting provisions, EU DAC8 Directive, and OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS) for international tax transparency.
tax_payment.consequences: Failure to settle outstanding taxes will result in automatic reporting to relevant tax authorities, potential criminal tax evasion charges, seizure of assets by tax authorities, and indefinite freezing of recovered funds.
howToProceed: Review the calculated tax liability based on your recovered assets
Submit the required tax settlement amount
Receive official tax clearance certificate
Documentation will be provided for your personal tax records
Funds will be cleared for release within 48-72 hours after settlement
tax_payment.contactInfo: For tax-related inquiries, consult with your tax advisor or contact our Tax Compliance Department at tax@coinly.com or call +1 800 123 4567 ext. 200

insurance_verification.title: Insurance & Liability Verification
insurance_verification.description: Prove legitimate ownership and non-involvement in fraud.
insurance_verification.legalDescription: As part of our asset recovery compliance protocol, you must obtain insurance coverage that certifies you are the legitimate owner of the recovered funds and that you were not complicit in any fraudulent activities.
whyRequired: Proves you are the rightful and legitimate owner of the recovered assets
Certifies you were a victim, not a participant in fraudulent activities
Required liability coverage for international fund transfers
Protection against future claims on recovered assets
Compliance with recovery platform insurance requirements
Required by regulatory authorities before fund release
insurance_verification.legalBasis: Required under asset recovery protocols established by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), and the International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS).
insurance_verification.consequences: Without insurance verification, we cannot certify your non-involvement in the fraudulent scheme. Assets will remain frozen pending investigation.
howToProceed: Review the insurance terms and liability declaration
Submit the insurance premium payment
Sign the liability waiver and non-complicity declaration
Receive your Certificate of Legitimate Ownership
Proceed to the next verification step
insurance_verification.contactInfo: For insurance inquiries, contact our Compliance Insurance Department at insurance@coinly.com or call +1 800 123 4567 ext. 250

aml_unodc_fees.title: UNODC AML Compliance Fees
aml_unodc_fees.description: United Nations anti-money laundering verification fees.
aml_unodc_fees.legalDescription: The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) mandates anti-money laundering verification for all recovered cryptocurrency assets exceeding certain thresholds.
whyRequired: UNODC compliance requirement for international asset recovery
Anti-money laundering investigation and certification
Verification that funds are not proceeds of criminal activity
Required for cross-border transfer of recovered digital assets
Financial Action Task Force (FATF) recommendation compliance
Protection against receiving tainted or illegal funds
aml_unodc_fees.legalBasis: Required under UNODC Model Legislation on Money Laundering, FATF Recommendations (particularly Recommendation 15 on Virtual Assets), EU AMLD6, and the Bank Secrecy Act.
aml_unodc_fees.consequences: Failure to complete UNODC AML verification will result in the assets being flagged as potentially tainted. You may face investigation by financial crimes units, and the funds will be permanently frozen.
howToProceed: Submit the UNODC AML compliance fee
Our team will initiate the comprehensive AML investigation
Investigation typically completes within 5-7 business days
Receive your UNODC AML Clearance Certificate
Assets will be cleared for final release
aml_unodc_fees.contactInfo: For AML compliance inquiries, contact our International Compliance Department at aml@coinly.com or call +1 800 123 4567 ext. 300

platform_fees.title: Release & Storage Fees
platform_fees.description: Platform storage, security, and release processing fees.
platform_fees.legalDescription: Your recovered assets have been securely stored in our cold storage infrastructure during the recovery process. This fee covers the secure storage costs, blockchain transaction fees for release, and administrative processing.
whyRequired: Coverage of secure cold storage infrastructure costs
Blockchain network transaction and gas fees for release
Multi-signature wallet security protocol implementation
24/7 monitoring and security during storage period
Administrative processing and legal documentation
Final compliance review and approval
platform_fees.legalBasis: Standard fee structure as outlined in the Asset Recovery Service Agreement and custodial service terms.
platform_fees.consequences: Processing cannot be initiated without payment of release and storage fees. Assets will continue to incur storage fees while held.
howToProceed: Confirm all previous verification steps have been completed
Submit the release and storage fee payment
Receive confirmation of payment
Fund release will be initiated within 24-48 hours
Funds will be transferred to your designated wallet address
platform_fees.contactInfo: For billing inquiries, contact our Billing Department at billing@coinly.com or call +1 800 123 4567 ext. 400

transaction_history.title: Banking History Establishment
transaction_history.description: Create transaction history between external account and Coinly.
transaction_history.legalDescription: To complete the secure transfer of your recovered assets, you must establish a transaction history between your external bank account or crypto wallet and your Coinly account.
whyRequired: Creates verifiable transaction history for regulatory compliance
Establishes banking relationship between accounts
Required by receiving financial institutions for large transfers
Demonstrates legitimate account activity pattern
Prevents flagging of large incoming transfers as suspicious
Ensures smooth processing at your destination bank
transaction_history.legalBasis: Required under bank compliance procedures for receiving large transfers, FATF Travel Rule requirements, and anti-fraud protocols.
transaction_history.consequences: Without established transaction history, your receiving bank or exchange may flag the incoming funds as suspicious, triggering an investigation.
howToProceed: Initiate small test transactions between your external account and Coinly
Complete the specified number of round-trip transactions
Each transaction establishes verified account connectivity
Allow 24-48 hours for history verification
Upon completion, final release will be scheduled
transaction_history.contactInfo: For transaction assistance, contact our Account Services at accounts@coinly.com or call +1 800 123 4567 ext. 450
